subject: GaiaHealth launch — Sales → CS handoff and Sprint 0 checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Carter <emily.carter@gaiahealth.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@gaiahealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T16:14:00Z
Subject: GaiaHealth launch — Sales → CS handoff (SOW + sprint0 asks)

Tessa / Karthik — attaching the SOW draft and a short preflight; requesting CS ownership and sprint0 plan so we can hit the committed go-live of 2026-08-12. Quick summary: 

- Account: GaiaHealth (payer-side analytics) — signed on 2026-06-18, committed MRR $18k.
- Scope for Sprint0: authentication, sandbox ingest of 3 sample datasets, config of region(us-east1), and creation of two service routes for low-latency inference.
- Key success metrics: <5% error rate on test prompts, average e2e latency under 300ms for p95 across acceptance samples, and token cost within agreed cap.

Primary risks I want on the radar:
1) Data ingestion format — engineering needs clear sample schemas before kickoff.
2) Sandbox GPU capacity — they may need reserved Dedicated during tests; we'll validate load.
3) Auth/KMS key access for their security team.

Attachments: GaiaHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), gaia-preflight-checklist.xlsx (preflight items we want filled).

Asks: 
- Tessa: please confirm CS owner and implementation lead.
- Karthik: can you be technical lead on the integration?
- Emily / Tom: if you can fill the preflight (spreadsheet) ahead of kickoff that helps us avoid scope creep in sprint0.

I'll stay on for the first kickoff to introduce the team but want CS to own the runbook and timeline.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: GaiaHealth launch — Sales → CS handoff (SOW + sprint0 asks)

Thanks Ben — assigning owners and noting the risks. TL;DR: we accept handoff and will own Sprint0 delivery.

Assignments:
- Implementation Lead (PM): Tessa Morgan (me) — overall runbook, checkpoints, exec updates.
- Integration / Technical Lead: Karthik Iyer — responsible for ingest schema, sandbox pipelines, and test harness.
- Security/Privacy SME: Mina Haddad — will coordinate KMS/HSM and data retention needs with their security team.

Proposed immediate next steps (this week):
1) Tessa to schedule 60-min kickoff with Gaia (30-min intro + 30-min technical breakout with Karthik).
2) Karthik to review their sample datasets and call out missing schema items in the preflight.
3) Mina to send a short list of KMS/credentials questions (we'll add to preflight).
4) Ben to confirm any procurement/contract quirks we need to track in renewal.

Timeline checkpoints:
- Preflight completed by 2026-06-29 (so we can scope Sprint0).
- Sprint0 planning & acceptance criteria by 2026-07-06.
- Go/no-go for integration by 2026-07-20.

Ben — copying the key owners above. I'll send a scheduling note to Emily & Tom with 3 windows and attach a slightly revised SOW (minor edits inline).

Date: 2026-06-23T14:30:00Z
Subject: GaiaHealth kickoff — proposed times + preflight items (please review)

Hi Emily / Tom — excited to get started. Ben shared the draft SOW and a short preflight — I'm the CS lead for your deployment and I'll own the Sprint0 runbook. Quick note on next steps and what we need from you before kickoff: 

1) Proposed kickoff windows (please pick one):
   • Thu Jun 25, 2026 — 10:00–11:00 PT (intro + tech breakout)
   • Fri Jun 26, 2026 — 09:00–10:00 PT
   • Mon Jun 29, 2026 — 11:00–12:00 PT
2) Preflight asks (attached spreadsheet):
   • Sample dataset (CSV/NDJSON) for the features we'll ingest (3 small files, ~5MB each)
   • Schema doc or notes about transforms to apply
   • API/network allowlist + any firewall IPs we should know about
   • Security contact and KMS owner for credentials swap
3) Attachments and links: 
   • Attached: GaiaHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (Ben's draft, I made small clarifying edits)
   • Attached: gaia-preflight-checklist.xlsx (please fill the yellow fields)
   • DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/gaia-sow-8934
4) What we'll run in Sprint0: sandbox ingest, basic model routing config, one end-to-end inference test harness, and documentation for acceptance.

If the proposed times work, I'll send a calendar invite with separate breakout for the technical team (Karthik + Mina). If you need a different timezone, tell me and we'll adjust.

Ben — thanks for the intro. Emily / Tom — cc'd Karthik and Mina who will join the technical session.

Cheers,

Thanks Tessa — Thu Jun 25 10:00 PT works for us. We'll aim to have the preflight spreadsheet completed by EOD Wed 6/24. A couple quick Qs before kickoff: 

1) Sandbox credentials — will you provision a temporary sandbox project for us or do we need to share credentials for our test environment?
2) Data retention settings — we need confirmation on default retention and whether custom retention policies can be applied per-route (we have one route with PHI-derived metadata that may require 30-day retention).

Tom and I will upload the sample CSVs to the shared folder today. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
